name: PayPal Payments
description: PayPal Payments is PayPal's business/merchant payment-processing offering — PayPal Checkout, Payment Links, invoicing, in-person card/QR payments, and a virtual terminal for accepting money online and in person. It is billed per transaction with no monthly platform fee, and merchants can reach PayPal's own reported base of up to 400 million active accounts as potential customers. This is distinct from the PayPal consumer wallet app.
best_for: Businesses of any size — from solopreneurs to large enterprises — that want to accept online and in-person payments without a monthly account fee, paying transaction fees only when they actually get paid.
features: PayPal Checkout for online payment acceptance (PayPal, Venmo, cards, Pay Later, digital wallets)
Payment Links and QR codes to accept payment without a website
Online invoicing with instant payment collection and automatic reminders
In-person acceptance via card-present terminals, QR codes, and Tap to Pay
Virtual Terminal for phone/mail-order card payments
Fastlane by PayPal: passwordless, autofilled guest checkout
Built-in Seller Protection on eligible transactions and PCI-compliant encrypted payment processing
PayPal Business mobile app (iOS/Android) for invoicing, refunds, and account activity
pros: No monthly account fee — merchants pay only when a transaction is processed
PCI-compliant processing, storage, and transmission of card data, per PayPal
Reaches PayPal's own reported base of up to 400 million active accounts as a pool of customers already familiar with the checkout
cons: Standard online rates (e.g., 2.99% + $0.49 per transaction on PayPal Checkout) run higher than the negotiated interchange-plus rates large processors can offer bigger merchants
Lower custom/interchange-plus rates for high-volume merchants require contacting PayPal rather than being available self-serve

pricing.starting_price: 2.29% + $0.09 per transaction (in-person, card present/QR) up to 4.99% + $0.49 (Pay Later)

tiers.name: Expanded Checkout (cards)
tiers.notes: Card fields embedded directly on the merchant's own checkout page.

tiers.name: PayPal/Venmo payments
tiers.notes: Paying with a PayPal or Venmo balance/account via Expanded Checkout.

tiers.name: In-person (card present/QR)
tiers.notes: Card-present and QR code payments; Tap to Pay starts at the same 2.29% card-present rate.

tiers.name: Invoicing
tiers.notes: Card payment on a PayPal invoice; PayPal/Venmo invoice payments are 3.49% + $0.49.

tiers.name: Virtual Terminal
tiers.notes: Phone/mail-order card payments entered by the merchant.

alternatives.name: Stripe
alternatives.description: A payments and financial-infrastructure API for accepting payments and managing billing/subscriptions.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses that want deep developer/API control over checkout and billing rather than a hosted, brand-forward checkout experience.

alternatives.name: Adyen
alternatives.description: An enterprise fintech platform offering payments, payouts, and financial products on a single API.
alternatives.best_for: Larger enterprises and platforms needing global scale, in-person plus online payments, and consolidated financial operations.
strengths: Global payouts and in-person POS on one API
